v11_pivot_outcome.architecture: v11 = v10 two-branch ensemble (v9 Agent || Direct Generic) + optional Controller VLM that arbitrates with per-domain RAG rulebook. learning_enabled=False is byte-equivalent to v10; learning_enabled=True invokes controller.
v11_pivot_outcome.learning_signal: Disagreement-based. Dev items where v9 and Direct split on 0.5 boundary → partitioned into A-wins / B-wins / agree-wrong / agree-correct. Meta-rule reflector (VLM w/ images) writes 1–3 routing rules per side from balanced K/2+K/2 sample. Domain-rules (invariants + corrective FN/FP) reused from the v3 pilot artifacts.
